title: verdict record
description: One measurement a gate made of one exact commit. A gate that did not run has no record, and the merge verb reads the absence as a refusal. Written by the step that ran the gate (push verification, the review verdict post, the merge verb's own checks) and read back by id or by head commit. schema_version is bumped on any change that an older reader would misread.

id.description: Record id: the UTC time it was written and eight random hex digits. Unique per record; the handle `show` reads by.

gate.description: Which gate measured. The kind, a colon and the configured name for a named gate: reviewer:<role>, pre_check:<label>, push.verify:<entry name>; the CI read is the bare name ci. Names come from the repository's and the deployment's own configuration.

head_sha.description: The exact commit the gate measured (a full SHA-1 or SHA-256 object name):for a push, the head read back from the remote after the push, not the head before commits were re-authored. A consumer matches this and no other commit.

tree_sha.description: The tree object of head_sha, when known.

repo.description: owner/repo the commit belongs to, when known. A record naming another repository does not count for this one.

spec_hash.description: Hash of the acceptance specification the gate measured against. Null until a specification is attached to the change.

tool.description: What measured: the verb or reader that produced the result.

exit.description: Result of the measurement. Zero passes; anything else is a failed measurement. A gate that never ran leaves no record at all.

started.description: UTC time the measurement began, to the second.

finished.description: UTC time the measurement ended, to the second.

evidence_ref.description: Where the evidence lives: a posted comment (comment:<id>), a test run id, a check name. Null when the record is its own evidence.

waiver.description: Reserved for the merge record: a stated reason a gate was waived for this commit. Null otherwise.
